## Activity

During May 2025, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 415 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and supports review of the service’s operational workload. The capture figure should be considered alongside the image quality and grading information below when assessing the overall performance reported for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 415 captures, 18 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result should continue to be monitored as part of routine site performance review. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and identify any continuing equipment or image-capture concerns.

## Grading

A total of 121 results were graded referable during May 2025. The median grading lag was 2. This records the midpoint of the reported waiting time for grading and should be read with the activity and image-quality measures. Together, the results describe the volume captured, the proportion that was ungradable, the number of referable results, and the timeliness of grading at Harbour Eye Clinic.
